description: Choose a moment. Give it a place to be shared.

cells.title: Choose a moment. Give it a place to be shared.
From story to published post
cells.text: Write, attach photos and video, then follow the upload and preparation stages. The result offers View post, Share post and My profile.

cells.alt: Paste a shared post into your website
cells.title: Paste a shared post into your website
cells.text: Copy the post link, insert !embed[ishare](URL) in the article body and save. Open the website, allow ishare and browse the photo and video together inside the article.

Publication immediately shows the actual embedded post. Open My profile to edit text or attachments, delete a post, or change whether it appears on the homepage. The post link stays the same after an edit.

Create a named API key in Personal center for AI image/video uploads. Keys share your account permissions and quotas. API-created posts stay off the homepage; the final Markdown includes post and media links. Native WebMCP can use selected composer files and manage your own posts when your browser supports it.
